scenario: Bulk paste: three risks in free text, slots partly pre-answered. The loop must parse, not interrogate.

given.titles: 1. Vendor API slips — if the Aug 20 date moves, launch slips 2 weeks (~$40k). Marco owns the fallback, scoped by Aug 15. 2. Cert dry run fails — we pay both processors for October, $6k. Dana reruns it by Sep 5. 3. Load test undone — no owner yet, cost unknown.

notes: Risks 1 and 2 arrive with trigger, consequence, cost, owner, and date in the paste. Risk 3 declares its owner and cost unknown — declared unknowns are refusals and go to Gaps, not questions. Open fields: severity per risk (3, or fewer if batched), risk 3's trigger, scope, next review — ceiling 6. Traps: (1) re-asking slots the paste already answered blows the ceiling — the 36-question failure mode; (2) severity is never stated and a register cannot assemble without it, so expect_document is false; (3) crediting Marco or Dana with risk 3's owner fails the trace.
